supporting_observations.claim: Repeated svc-ledger authentication failures occur at roughly one-minute intervals from FILE-SUN-01. The records show incorrect-password status (0xc000006a) and identify FILE-SUN-01 as the workstation; the pattern is consistent with the inventory description of LedgerSync re-authenticating every minute.
Domain-controller records also show svc-ledger authentication failures, including Kerberos pre-authentication status 0x18 and credential-validation status 0xc000006a, with source IP 10.55.20.20.

At 13:34:53 UTC, a separate explicit-credentials event on WS-ZADAMS-01 shows SYSTEM running PowerShell with target account svc-ledger and target server PROXY-SUN-01. This is an unexpected use of the service account from a workstation based on the supplied inventory, but the event alone does not establish whether authentication succeeded or what action followed.

The supplied records do not include process command-line details or corroborating network records for the PowerShell event.
